notes.title: Post-Next Fest Bug Fixes and Updates - v.0.3.5
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone! I just updated the demo to v.0.3.5 to fix some complaints and bug reports that came up during Steam Next Fest. Read on to see a list of the changes made!

I'll start by saying thank you for a great Next Fest! It was my first time participating, and it was amazing to see everyone playing and experiencing the game for the first time. There were over 2,000 new players that jumped into Tic Tactic during the week![/p][p]
[/p][h2]A new and improved Equipment Panel[/h2][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdQQnV3fZa2gdfvxuq-aSBTYOhp8KGL1C9HjgHzrL8l_va75pwBHjeeUbdViNpIQnOn13EZ4FwKoZmOHdFM6KE1jR7mxOv5XdKATJdIbxt00VFTqExZqh9pNp-FYCe7N84J38O6?key=4_BOdjSdEuJQ8QrFwn74tfIw"][/img][/p][p]Many of you may have noticed that the Equipment Panel was… not the best. It was functional, but there were several issues with the overall presentation.[/p][p]
[/p][p]I fixed some of the formatting issues and added an indicator that highlights the currently equipped weapon. In addition, I made it so that updating your equipped weapon is updated in the save file, so you can restart a fight without having to re-equip your weapons.[/p][p]

[/p][h2]Updated Leaderboard Implementation[/h2][p]This is good news and bad news. I’ll start with the bad news… Existing scores will no longer appear on the leaderboard. I know, and I apologize. Some of these scores were invalid, anyway, but it was a necessary step.

[/p][p]The good news is that I have moved over to using the Steam Leaderboard system. Scores will automatically be stored within Steam, and will eventually be visible in the Steam Community. [/p][p]
[/p][p]Of course, participation is not mandatory. Just click the Welcome Message in the Main Menu to toggle network functions on and off.[/p][p]
[/p][p]In the same vein, there is now a [u][url="https://www.speedrun.com/Tic_Tactic"]Speedrun[/url][/u] page for Tic Tactic, so there are many ways to compete![/p][p]
[/p][h2]Other Fixes[/h2][p]I tried to get through as many bugs as I could in this quick update. Here’s a list of some of the ones that have been handled:[/p][list][*][p]End Game Screen would not appear after the first run. It was an error that spilled over from the previous run, somehow. I rearranged some things to take care of this.[/p][/*][*][p]By popular demand, I decreased the difficulty of the final boss. Rather than gaining shield every turn, he will only gain shield every [i]other[/i] turn, giving you a better opportunity to take a swing at him.[/p][/*][*][p]There were a few overlap issues that I handled, such as with the Trader. I took care of [i]most[/i], but some, like the End Turn button, remain. Let me know if you find one and I will add it to the list.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the lighting on a variety of in-game items and objects, like the Shrine.[/p][/*][*][p]There were a bunch of missing pink textures. The cause of this was actually a huge and terrifying problem, but luckily it was not a huge undertaking to fix.[/p][/*][*][p]Apparently, the tooltips in the Deck Panel were inaccessible! Well, they work now.[/p][/*][*][p]The Deck Panel also had a bug that would cause it to act up at the end of a match. That bug is fixed, but I also set the panel to automatically close when the match is over.[/p][/*][*][p]There were a few little hitches with the save system that required some rewriting. [b]This may cause inconsistencies or incompatibility with existing saves[/b], depending on how old they are.[/p][/*][*][p]The Settings tab no longer switches with the Shift key if you are in the Feedback panel.[/p][/*][*][p]The tooltip for the first reward no longer opens when it spawns unless you are using a Gamepad. The reason is that the item was immediately selected so that you would be able to use a controller to click it, but this only needs to happen… well, if you’re using a controller.[/p][/*][/list][p]

[/p][p]I’m still working through some existing issues, but please feel free to submit a bug report if you run into an issue that has not been listed here, and I’ll get on it right away! Some things I plan on working on include:[/p][list][*][p]Updates to the Tangle tiles[/p][/*][*][p]Adding Windowed mode to Settings[/p][/*][*][p]Making some updates to Enemy AI to make it a bit more difficult to trick[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p]As always, you can keep up with me in the Steam Discussions or on Discord! Otherwise, see you next time.[/p][p]
- unbreaded[/p]

notes.title: BIG UPDATE! Say hello to Demo v.0.3.2
notes.notes:
The demo has been updated to v.0.3.2! Boot it up to see some new content, lots of little fixes, and an overall better experience. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332768/b9c349063046f5d7f04e79f124c3aa7c9eb1d60e.png[/img]

[h2]New Content[/h2]
This update features several new tiles:
[list]
[*] Crit
[*] Shield (previous Shield tile has been renamed to Armored)
[*] Thorn
[*] Negative
[*] Parasite
[*] Slime
[/list]
… and more! There are also some new encounters, fixes to existing encounters, and some new items to discover.

[h2]Overall Fixes[/h2]
I corrected some big issues with the map that were preventing progress, so thank you to everyone that reported the issue in the previous version! In addition to the map, I included a few other little changes:
[list]
[*] Increased the speed of end-of-turn by 0.5 seconds to make matches move a little faster.
Updated some save system code. NOTE: This may cause issues with existing saves, so please finish up your runs BEFORE updating.
[*] Added the ability to manually enter a random seed.
[*] Fixed some bugs for controllers.
[*] In-game notification system that lets you know when certain effects have happened, as well as when the game saves. There’s also a notification icon that pops up when you collect a new weapon, which should help remind you to update your equipment!
[*] Added tooltips to enemies to explain effects or add a bit of lore. The descriptions are still a work-in-progress, though, so some may be blank.
[*] Cleaned and juiced-up some animations
[/list]

I appreciate all the feedback so far! Keep it coming; it makes the game better! Share your thoughts in the Steam Discussions, through the in-game feedback form, or in our Discord community. 

And, if you enjoyed the game so far, you can leave your thoughts in the form of a review–it helps more people figure out if it’s right for them!


Until next time.
- unbreaded
